description: Implementation of resource grid pool management, including reservation, release, and asynchronous zeroing of resource grids within a telecommunication system, with specific focus on resource grid pooling and concurrency control.

classes.name: resource_grid_pool_wrapper
classes.description: Wrapper managing reservation, release, and zeroing of resource grids with concurrency control and optional asynchronous zeroing.

classes.name: resource_grid_pool_impl
classes.description: Implementation of resource grid pool handling allocation and stopping control.

methods.name: try_reserve
methods.description: Attempts to reserve a resource grid, transitioning its state if successful.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a reserved resource grid, making it available again.

methods.name: notify_release_scope
methods.description: Handles zeroing of the grid asynchronously if configured, then releases it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a reference to the managed resource grid.

methods.name: allocate_resource_grid
methods.description: Allocates a resource grid based on a slot point, with logging if unavailable.
